entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Camera Commands Reach the Autopilot
value: Giữ lệnh camera khi upload.
evidence_span: - **Camera Commands Reach the Autopilot**: Camera trigger, image capture and video capture commands in a mission are now sent to ArduPilot as they are, the way QGC sends them. Previously they were replaced with empty placeholders on upload, so the autopilot never fired the camera on its own.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Surveys Laid Out the Way QGC Lays Them
value: Lưới nhập theo QGC.
evidence_span: - **Surveys Laid Out the Way QGC Lays Them**: Opening a QGroundControl `.plan` now reproduces the same grid — same angle, same line count, same spacing phase. A survey that used to come out a quarter turn from the angle you typed now lies where you asked for it.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Correct Area, Time and Photos
value: Sửa tổng khảo sát.
evidence_span: - **Correct Area, Time and Photos**: Three numbers in the mission summary were wrong. Area was reported 100× too small, Est. Time was computed at a hover speed nothing in the app ever sets instead of your cruise speed, and Photos showed the selected pattern's count rather than the whole mission's. All three are now right, and a mission with two surveys adds them up.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Photo Counts You Can Trust
value: Sửa khoảng chụp và làm tròn.
evidence_span: - **Photo Counts You Can Trust**: Camera trigger spacing no longer applies the frontal overlap a second time, shots are rounded per transect the way QGC rounds them, and a camera with no usable footprint now reports no triggering instead of an absurd number. **Expect survey shot counts to differ from earlier versions** — these are the corrected figures, and the hover-and-capture points generated along each line moved with them.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Layout Settings Survive a Round Trip
value: Giữ tùy chọn lưới qua nhập xuất.
evidence_span: - **Layout Settings Survive a Round Trip**: Entry corner, alternate transects and split-concave polygons are now written on export and read back on import, so a saved mission reopens as the grid you saved instead of being re-laid from a default corner.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Each Waypoint Its Own Altitude Mode
value: Chế độ cao độ từng waypoint.
evidence_span: - **Each Waypoint Its Own Altitude Mode**: A waypoint can fly relative to launch, above terrain, or at an absolute (AMSL) altitude, chosen in its own panel. The mode is saved with the waypoint and survives export and import.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Above Terrain, Calculated for You
value: Đổi terrain sang AMSL; chặn khi thiếu.
evidence_span: - **Above Terrain, Calculated for You**: For terrain-following waypoints, RAGAS works out the AMSL altitude from elevation data. A mission whose terrain could not be fetched is not exported with a wrong altitude.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Where It Runs
value: 3D dành cho Android ARM64.
evidence_span: - **Where It Runs**: Android controllers with 64-bit ARM hardware. On anything else the 3D button is simply not offered, rather than shown and then failing.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Plan On the Surface
value: Sửa điểm trên địa hình.
evidence_span: - **Plan On the Surface**: Waypoints and survey boundaries sit on the ground where you put them. Drag a waypoint across the terrain, or drag its altitude handle to raise and lower it, and the flight line follows the hillside underneath.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Quick to Come Back To
value: Giữ góc nhìn và cache terrain.
evidence_span: - **Quick to Come Back To**: Switching to 2D and back keeps your 3D camera where you left it, and terrain tiles are cached so revisited ground loads without waiting on the network.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Trigger Distance 0 in Manual
value: Khoảng 0 hiện số ảnh chưa biết.
evidence_span: - **Trigger Distance 0 in Manual**: A Manual camera on a survey or corridor scan accepts a Trigger Distance of 0, so the photos can be taken another way — for example by time from a waypoint command. The planner then shows the photo count as `--` rather than a misleading 0.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Photos Taken vs Planned
value: Tách số ảnh báo về và dự kiến.
evidence_span: - **Photos Taken vs Planned**: While a mission flies, the Photos figure shows the shots the aircraft actually reported against the number planned, for example `37/120`. A mission with no planned count shows the shots taken so far.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / More Capture Options
value: Hover, refly và turnaround.
evidence_span: - **More Capture Options**: Surveys offer hover-and-capture, refly at 90° and images in turnarounds, and the hover time at each photo can be set from 1 to 60 seconds.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Warned Before It Is Too Fast
value: Cảnh báo vượt nhịp camera.
evidence_span: - **Warned Before It Is Too Fast**: When the flight speed and trigger spacing would ask the camera to fire faster than it can, the camera panel says so.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Ground Clearance Chart
value: Độ hở theo terrain dưới máy bay.
evidence_span: - **Ground Clearance Chart**: The Play Mission panel shows the terrain around the aircraft with your planned altitude line over it and the path already flown. The height above ground is read from the actual terrain under the drone, not the takeoff point.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / GSD You Can Rely On
value: GSD thuộc nhiệm vụ đã upload.
evidence_span: - **GSD You Can Rely On**: The GSD in the Play Mission panel now comes from the mission's own camera patterns. Previously it depended on which item happened to be selected when you uploaded, so it sometimes vanished and sometimes showed a value from another survey.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Resume Where It Stopped
value: Resume từ waypoint đã tới cuối.
evidence_span: - **Resume Where It Stopped**: An interrupted mission resumes at the waypoint it last reached, not the one after it, so no ground is skipped.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Choose How It Takes Off
value: Hai cách lấy độ cao cất cánh.
evidence_span: - **Choose How It Takes Off**: Safe Takeoff climbs to the safe takeoff altitude before heading to the first point. Direct Ascent climbs straight to the first point's altitude, then flies level to it.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Type the Exact Position
value: Nhập vị trí bằng số.
evidence_span: - **Type the Exact Position**: Waypoints, takeoff and pattern corners have latitude and longitude fields and a nudge pad, so a point can be set to a surveyed coordinate or moved a step at a time.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Circle Fence Around Home
value: Fence tròn quanh Home.
evidence_span: - **Circle Fence Around Home**: A circular fence can be set around the home point, and the fence editor has been reworked to be easier to edit.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Cameras Found Automatically
value: Tự nhận diện các camera.
evidence_span: - **Cameras Found Automatically**: Cameras on the payload are discovered and identified on their own, and the settings for each camera sit in one panel.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Reboot the Aircraft From RAGAS
value: Gửi reboot và báo thất bại.
evidence_span: - **Reboot the Aircraft From RAGAS**: When a change only takes effect after a restart, RAGAS offers to reboot the aircraft and tells you if the reboot fails.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Takeoff Placed by Tap Counts
value: Đổi takeoff cập nhật dự toán.
evidence_span: - **Takeoff Placed by Tap Counts**: Dropping the takeoff point on the map now recalculates distance, time and photos immediately.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED

entity: v4.0.14-b111 / Camera Commands on a Waypoint
value: Chụp theo thời gian tại waypoint.
evidence_span: - **Camera Commands on a Waypoint**: A waypoint can now start image capture, with an interval and a photo count, or stop it — the same commands QGC offers.
scope: Maintainer claim for this release; binary behavior NOT_CHECKED
